visual_logic.surface_detail: Leathery, 'Ivory' and 'Soft Beige' skin with subtle specular highlights on the neck vertebrae, running continuously along its hyper-elongated horizontal profile.
visual_logic.environment: White limestone 'Plattenkalk' floor with high-key ground reflection. Ground elements are shifted entirely into the lowest background layers to preserve a crisp lower silhouette.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The impossibly long, stiff neck remains the hero element, aligned completely straight and parallel to the frame boundaries.

pose: The unique reptile is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, positioned horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original stationary sandbar crane pose is converted into a flat, level horizontal trajectory, stretching its small head, hyper-extended rod-like neck, compact torso, limbs, and long tail end-to-end to trace flawlessly alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
